primaryCodebook.defaultPolicy: No TZONE missing/default/sentinel code is defined in Table 3; blank, zero, and unlisted values remain unresolved. Existing TIME sentinel safeguards remain pending original export-lineage review.

knownFlagPolicy.': publication date; exclude from occurrence chronology
knownFlagPolicy.+: local time at documented standard code offset plus exactly 60 minutes
knownFlagPolicy.-: date uncertainty of one or two days; do not accept exact occurrence day
explicit source standard time at documented code offset
knownFlagPolicy.=: date believed erroneous; exclude from occurrence chronology
knownFlagPolicy.blank: unspecified time scale; do not assert DST or standard
knownFlagPolicy.other: hold combined/undocumented flags for source review

primaryCodebook.numericOffsetInference: For listed codebook TZONE values only, standard UTC offset minutes = (TZONE - 12) * 60. This mapping is inferred from the code table; TZONE itself is not an hours-west offset.
primaryCodebook.regionPolicy: REGION CA is Central America; CN is Canada. STATE is country/state code; REGION is not an ISO country code.
